turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Who decided to give Owen a zero, and did anyone speak to him first?
I entered the zero before I called you. That was wrong, and I own it.
Okay. Now tell me what the zero was based on.

Here's the version history. The document was created Wednesday October 28 at 11:31 PM, title only. At 11:52 PM 612 words arrive in one edit. At 11:58 PM another 794. Then small edits. No earlier drafts.
I'm writing those times down. He could have drafted it somewhere else and pasted it in. Was any of this put to Owen before you entered the zero?
So he wrote nothing until almost midnight the night before it was due, and then fourteen hundred words appeared in six minutes.
"Appeared." Pasting in a draft written somewhere else looks exactly like that on a log. And you still haven't told me whether anyone heard Owen before that zero went in.
What was he doing at midnight that night?
I'm not the one being questioned here. He's been up late enough this fall without— Answer me: did anyone speak to Owen before you entered that zero?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still expect the zero withdrawn, an apology, a straight answer on whether Owen was heard before the mark was entered, and a written confirmation that nothing about this essay is in his record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Still at her opening position, having agreed to nothing; she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, an answer on whether Owen was heard first, and nothing on his record, and the fair outcome, a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, was never put on the table.
What moved her: Owning in one sentence that you entered the zero before calling home earned a small sign of ground, because she cares about procedure and you stopped defending the indefensible.
What cost ground: When she said he could have written it elsewhere and pasted it in, you restated the times instead of answering with something she could check, then asked what he was doing at midnight, which made her his lawyer rather than a reader of your evidence.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your version history put the work on the night of October 28 after 11:30 PM, very close to that kind of night, which is why she slipped once about how late he has been up and then covered it with procedure; it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: Right after showing the version history, answer her question about whether Owen was heard, then meet her pasting defence with something checkable from his own work and offer the 4.4 rewrite in writing, private, with nothing on his record.
